title: A set operator on Null
question: Does AWS accept ForAllValues:Null, and what does it do? AWS doesn't say what a set operator does on Null. The analyzer refuses the policy.

cases.name: for_all_values_null_false
cases.description: ForAllValues:Null aws:TagKeys false, for a request that adds the tag campus.

readings.ALLOW: AWS accepts it, and the key is there
readings.IMPLICIT_DENY: AWS accepts it, and the condition doesn't hold

cases.name: for_all_values_null_false_key_absent
cases.description: Second follow-up: ForAllValues:Null aws:TagKeys false, for a request with no tags. Plain Null false fails on a missing key; ForAllValues holds on one.

readings.ALLOW: the set operator applies: ForAllValues holds on a missing key, as with other operators
readings.IMPLICIT_DENY: the set operator is ignored: Null false fails on a missing key

cases.name: for_any_value_null_true_key_absent
cases.description: Second follow-up: ForAnyValue:Null aws:TagKeys true, for a request with no tags. Plain Null true holds on a missing key; ForAnyValue fails on one.

readings.IMPLICIT_DENY: the set operator applies: ForAnyValue fails on a missing key, as with other operators
readings.ALLOW: the set operator is ignored: Null true holds on a missing key
